slot_note: the slot's seed DA21 (a nonprofit health plan's 2027 intensive track) lends its world and decision shape only; architecture 3 keeps a nonprofit health plan deciding which parts of its work get a 2027 programme and moves the deciding quantity to the breast cancer penetrance of recurrent pathogenic variants, estimated from the plan's referred families
niche: a health system's inherited cancer service estimating each variant group's breast cancer risk by 70 from the families referred to it, where relatives who already have cancer are tested in their own care far more often than relatives who do not, and the 2027 Family Outreach Program takes on the groups whose carriers face at least a 30 percent risk
answer: The program takes on the PALB2 protein-truncating and PALB2 missense groups and none of the other eight.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every relationship, age and final report correctly, leaves the probands and half-sisters out and runs Kaplan-Meier on the relatives whose final report shows the family's variant files PALB2-PTV, PALB2-MIS, ATM-MIS, BARD1-PTV and RAD51D-PTV (43.9, 84.4, 46.2, 41.1, 33.6 percent): the late groups' tested relatives are mostly women tested for a breast cancer of their own; only every relative with the one-half prior names the two PALB2 groups.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each variant group's penetrance, the cumulative breast cancer risk by 70 of a woman who carries a variant in it, which genetic epidemiology estimates from families with the probands set aside and every first-degree relative carried through Mendelian inheritance (the kin-cohort or a segregation likelihood); with stores or schools in place of families nothing passes a trait to half a member's kin, so there is no prior to carry the untested and the call stops making sense.
layer1: the register's pedigree export, one row a person, relationships coded to the proband, ages as of each family's history date, birth year only for relatives who are not patients
the reference laboratory's legacy variant names to February 2021 against the system laboratory's HGVS after
amended reports (May 2024) and re-analysis reports (from August 2023) replacing the reports they supersede
half-siblings coded apart from full siblings
enterprise IDs on MRI orders kept from before a duplicate registration's merge
first-course breast surgery in the tumor registry only before the 2019 EHR cutover
stakeholder_role: genetic epidemiologist of the health system's Inherited Cancer Risk Service

spine.entity: one row is one person in a referred family's pedigree

world.org_type: nonprofit health system (38 hospitals in six western states, based in Denver)

driver: The decisive quantity is the chance that a member carrying an inherited trait develops an outcome by a fixed age, estimated from clusters that reached the record because one member had the outcome, where the other members are checked for the trait far more often once they have the outcome; leaving out the members who brought each cluster in and taking the members checked and found to carry the trait still credits the trait with the outcomes that prompted the checks, most where unaffected members have seldom been checked, and only every member's history, each carrying the trait with the probability inheritance gives unless a check settles it, recovers the risk.
driver_concrete: Each variant group's breast cancer risk by 70 for a woman who carries a variant in it, estimated from the mothers, sisters and daughters of the probands referred to the health system's Inherited Cancer Risk Service, where relatives with breast cancer are tested in their own care or invited first while unaffected relatives are tested only if they answer a letter, and for the four groups identified late (BARD1 and RAD51D added to the panel in 2023, the PALB2 and ATM missense variants reclassified in 2024) few unaffected relatives have answered; every relative counts, a carrier with probability one half unless a final report settles it (kin-cohort or Mendelian likelihood), not the relatives whose report shows the variant.
stump: A competent solver sets the probands aside, runs Kaplan-Meier on the relatives whose final report shows the family's variant and names five groups for the 2027 Family Outreach Program, PALB2 protein-truncating, PALB2 missense, ATM missense, BARD1 and RAD51D, because the late groups' tested relatives are mostly women tested for a cancer of their own; only every mother, sister and daughter with the one-half prior (the kin-cohort or the Mendelian likelihood) puts ATM missense, BARD1 and RAD51D at 18, 16 and 12 percent and names the two PALB2 groups.

differentiation.task180: task180 v4 restores the small events a daily noise cycle masks at the instruments; task271 v3 records every relative's history in full, and the selection is in which relatives were tested for the family's variant
differentiation.task456: task456 v1 recovers a prevalence from three records that miss and misflag; task271 v3 has exact tests, and its bias is which relatives took one, mostly once they had cancer
differentiation.task462: task462 v1 weights each detected source by a size-dependent detection probability from blind trials; task271 v3 weights nothing by detection: an untested relative carries the family's variant with Mendel's probability one half
differentiation.task196: task196 v2 recovers an event total from two dependent capture channels; task271 v3 estimates a risk among carriers whose genotypes the records hold only for the relatives tested
differentiation.task255: task255 v1 fits a size distribution through each item's floor and ceiling; task271 v3 truncates and censors nothing by size: relatives selected themselves for testing by their own outcome
differentiation.task268: task268 v2 read a stock's fall from a fixed survey against catch rates that follow the stock; task271 v3 reads a carrier risk from families in which relatives were tested mostly because they were ill
differentiation.task249: task249 v4 counts the distinct units behind identifiers that expire after an idle gap; task271 v3 estimates a carrier risk from relatives selected for testing by their outcome
differentiation.task267: task267 corrects a screen's capture rate for a reference check given by design to flagged members and a random fifth; task271 v3 has no sampling design: relatives chose testing, mostly once ill, and Mendelian inheritance rather than a sampling fraction carries the untested
differentiation.task230: task230 v1 carries a classification bias measured on a checked part to a later channel's part; task271 v3 carries no measured bias: the untested relatives' genotypes follow Mendel's one half

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each unit's outcome rate against what its cases' prior state would produce, where a strong risk property of some cases is recorded only in their earlier episodes at other units and concentrates at the units that receive referrals, so a risk model built from the current episode alone charges those units for their cases' history.
lineage.architecture: v1 (Corrisbrook Health Cooperative's 2027 Pancreatic Surgery Centres, three of eight Wisconsin hospitals by 90-day deaths after pancreatic resection against a pooled risk model, an earlier pancreas or bile duct operation rebuilt from the patients' earlier admissions)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-19 at stage 4: both isolated scored readers built a prior hepatobiliary or pancreatic operation from the patients' earlier admissions through the documented person key and committed the golden call (Netherfold, Ferncastle, Aldermoor); a history look-back is the field's comorbidity reflex; the judge returned SEND_BACK on the earlier-operation flag's unfiled definition
lineage.driver_concrete: Each eligible hospital's 90-day deaths after pancreatic resection in 2023 to 2025 against the deaths its patients' pre-operative condition would produce at the eight hospitals together, with an earlier operation on the pancreas or bile ducts, recorded only in the patient's earlier admissions anywhere in the state, as a risk factor; the two referral centres perform most re-operations.
lineage.stump: A competent solver risk-adjusts on the index admission's own record, finds Aldermoor's ratio at 0.95 and names Netherfold, Ferncastle and Farrowmere; only adding the earlier pancreatic or bile-duct operation, rebuilt from the patients' earlier admissions statewide since 2016, brings Aldermoor's ratio to 0.87 and names Netherfold, Ferncastle and Aldermoor.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the share of a group's members holding a state that keeps them away at the hours most attempts to reach them are made, measured only on the members who could be reached, with every attempt on every member logged with its hour; weighting the reached members to the group's recorded attributes, or carrying the last-reached members' share to the never reached, leaves the shortfall, and only a model of each state's chance of being reached in each window of the day, fitted to the attempt histories of reached and never-reached members together, gives the share among those never reached.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each Washington region's share of the plan's expansion members aged 19 to 64 who worked 80 hours or more in March 2026, from the spring member work survey, where members in work rarely answer weekday daytime calls and the regions' calls went out by day in different measure; a callback model of each work class's chance of answering in each calling window, fitted to every sampled member's call history across the two centres' logs, gives the share among the members never reached.
lineage.stump: A competent solver weights each region's respondents to its sampled members' age and sex, or carries the late-reached respondents' share in work to the members never reached, and names Pierce, North Sound, King and Spokane, North Sound in place of Thurston-Mason; only the callback model on the two centres' call records, each work class's answer rate by calling window, recovers the unreached members' share in work and names Pierce, Spokane, King and Thurston-Mason.
lineage.architecture: v2 (Trevanna Community Health Plan's 2027 Community Engagement Support track: which four of ten Washington Apple Health regions by the share of expansion members who worked 80 hours in March 2026, a latent class callback model of the member survey's call records)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-20 at stage 4: both isolated scored readers fitted the latent class callback model on every sampled member's call history and landed the call (one took every graded figure); the judge returned SEND_BACK, a level-of-effort logit extrapolated to the unreached naming North Sound fourth

notes: Registered with --force on 2026-10-20 on the author's explicit instruction (option a): the two remaining BLOCKs are coincidences of the coarse key, not a repeated driver. ban.shape against task249 v4: task249 was retired on 2026-10-20 (RETIRED commit, four architectures spent) and its card was never marked architecture_spent by its author, so the guard reads a dead build as a live neighbour; shape 10 is the honest shape of a threshold scorecard, and a ranked slate under a cap would let the share of all relatives affected rank the variants without the analysis. test.same_driver against task268 v2 (lineage): the shared triple is population, G12, method_or_model_selection; task268 v2 read a stock's fall from a fixed survey against fleet catch rates, a different driver (differentiation on this card). G12 (an untested relative's blank genotype is a non-answer) and G14 (the tested carriers' rate does not apply to all carriers) are the honest decisive keys; G6 and G3 would pass the guard and describe the mechanism less well. Stage 3 (2026-10-21): the deciding forum redrawn from committee_or_panel to line_manager_or_team: the service's medical director, the requester's own manager, adopts the groups in February 2027 under the Clinical Programs Committee's criteria (criteria 1.3), so the committee files the standard and does not decide; the redraw answers ban.forum against task471 v5, which entered this card's window when task251's card was marked architecture_spent after this card was filed. Re-registered with --force on the author's instruction (option a, 2026-10-21) over ban.strategy against task471 v5: population_selection is the honest label of this mechanism (the relatives whose genotypes the records hold are selected on their own diagnosis) and no other strategy key describes it; task471 v5 selects a different population on a different ground (differentiation unchanged).
